text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, pancytopenia (low leukocytes, lymphocytes, neutrophils, platelets, and mild anemia), elevated INR, and high ferritin, suggesting significant inflammation or possible infection/sepsis with coagulopathy. Lymphopenia and neutropenia raise concern for immunosuppression. Elevated monocytes, basophils, and albumin are noted. Immediate clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
